question: As per the Union Budget of India 2022-23, India’s economic growth is estimated to be ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**9.2%**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the Union Budget 2022-23, India's economic growth was estimated to be **9.2%**.
 
• This projection was based on the strong economic recovery post-pandemic.
 
• However, the actual growth rate for the fiscal year 2022-23, as per the revised estimates released later, was slightly lower at **7%**.
 
• It's important to note that these are annual growth rates.
 
• Economic growth can fluctuate quarter-to-quarter, and factors like global economic conditions, domestic policies, and geopolitical events can influence these rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Union Budget of India is an annual financial statement presented by the Finance Minister to the Parliament.
 
• It outlines the government's estimated revenue and expenditure for the upcoming fiscal year.
 
• **Key Components of the Union Budget:**
 
• **Revenue Receipts:** Income generated through taxes (direct and indirect) and other sources.
 
• **Capital Receipts:** Income generated through borrowings and other capital assets.
 
• **Revenue Expenditure:** Expenditure on day-to-day functioning of the government, like salaries, pensions, and subsidies.
 
• **Capital Expenditure:** Expenditure on creating assets, such as infrastructure projects, defense equipment, and public sector investments.
